mapper.sql: id, combination_id, head_id, user_id, order_id, required_members, expire_time, status, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_combination_pink (combination_id, head_id, user_id, order_id, required_members, expire_time, status, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{combinationId}, #{headId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{requiredMembers}, #{expireTime}, #{status}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select from litemall_combination_pink where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select from litemall_combination_pink where (id = #{headId} or head_id = #{headId}) and deleted = 0 order by id asc
select count(*) from litemall_combination_pink where (id = #{headId} or head_id = #{headId}) and deleted = 0
select from litemall_combination_pink where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by add_time desc, id desc
select from litemall_combination_pink where head_id = 0 and status = 0 and expire_time < #{now} and deleted = 0 order by expire_time asc
